heading: Our Proven Flutter App Development Process is Smart, Lean, & Agile
text2: Our flutter app development process runs from understanding your idea to launching and supporting the finished product. Each step has a clear outcome so you always know what is happening and what comes next.

items.title: Discovery Workshop
items.text: We sit down with you to understand your idea, users and goals for Flutter App Development, and agree on scope, priorities and success measures.

items.title: Technical Analysis
items.text: We choose the right platform, architecture and integrations for Flutter App Development, and flag technical risks early.

items.title: UI/UX Prototyping
items.text: Interactive prototypes let you tap through the app and approve flows before any code is written.

items.title: Launch and Support
items.text: We publish to the stores, monitor the release and keep improving the app after launch.

items.title: Build and Test in Sprints
items.text: The app is built in short sprints with testing at every milestone on real devices.

items.title: Functional Specification
items.text: Every screen, feature and API is documented so developers, designers and testers work from one plan.
